comparison.objective: Hold a funnel and pour beads through it; candidate separates media from oversized workpieces with a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual funnel alignment and direct bead pouring versus screen loading, orientation-dependent passage, bridge clearing, and retained-part control.
comparison.success_condition: No numeric rubric is provided; intended success is beads poured through funnel. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, and no spill.
comparison.reason: This is the closest board primitive, but a funnel merely channels one material; it does not test selective screening or bridge release.
